script.problem: It has 38 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: The notes offer ruling the land and returning to the land as different explanations, but “also” makes them sound like one combined meaning. Present them as different views.
“Conqueror,” “chariot,” and especially “strongholds” may be difficult for a 10-year-old. Use simpler words or briefly explain them.
